sections.title: Complete Layer 7 Summary
sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              ALL 8 ADVANCED RAG PATTERNS — SUMMARY               │
├──────────────┬───────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┤
│  Pattern     │  Solves                   │  Use When             │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  CRAG        │  Bad docs retrieved       │  Unreliable/outdated  │
│              │  Self-corrects via grading│  knowledge base       │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  Self-RAG    │  Unnecessary retrieval    │  Mixed query types    │
│              │  Unsupported answers      │  Need self-awareness  │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  HyDE        │  Short/vague queries      │  Sparse queries,      │
│              │  Poor embedding matches   │  technical topics     │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  Multi-Hop   │  Multi-part questions     │  Chain of reasoning   │
│              │  Single hop not enough    │  Entity relationships │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  Fusion RAG  │  Incomplete retrieval     │  Comparison queries   │
│              │  One query angle misses   │  Broad topics         │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  GraphRAG    │  Entity relationships     │  Knowledge graphs     │
│              │  Cross-doc connections    │  Enterprise KB        │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  Agentic RAG │  Complex multi-aspect Q's │  Research questions   │
│              │  Needs iterative search   │  Deep analysis        │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│  Adaptive RAG│  Wrong strategy for query │  Production systems   │
│              │  One-size-fits-all fails  │  Diverse query types  │
└──────────────┴───────────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘

  DECISION GUIDE — WHICH PATTERN TO USE?
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  "My retrieved docs are often irrelevant"     → CRAG
  "Agent wastes money on unnecessary retrieval"→ Self-RAG
  "Queries are short, retrieval quality is low"→ HyDE
  "Question needs multiple pieces connected"   → Multi-Hop RAG
  "Need comprehensive coverage of a topic"     → Fusion RAG
  "Questions about entity relationships"       → GraphRAG
  "Complex research with multiple aspects"     → Agentic RAG
  "Different query types need different RAG"   → Adaptive RAG
  "Build one system to handle ALL query types" → Adaptive RAG
```
